title: Recorder Reconstruction
source: game-design/08_PUZZLE_DESIGNS.md P-04; game-design/22_PUZZLE_CLUE_DESIGN.md §4.3-4.4; game-design/24_NARRATIVE_REVISION.md §2.2 and §4 rows 4-9; full-game-story/STORY_FULL.md EX-CH02-S07..S11

learn.label: Learn · provenance before playback
learn.goal: Photograph the old labels without damaging them and keep a source attached to every claim.
learn.takeaway: A device match answers which device, not when it was used, what the trial reached, or who used it.

apply.label: Apply · rebuild the local copy
apply.goal: Give each file its one supported date, device or channel, check the local copy, then open the transcript.
apply.takeaway: An intact file supports reliable playback. It does not prove who is speaking.

twist.label: Twist · observed, inferred, unknown
twist.goal: Hear both stored voices, keep the familiar voice as an inference, and send the evidence without a guessed name.
twist.takeaway: Sounding like someone is an inference; the date on the file is a fact. Delivered is not the same as answered.

source_labels.label: Original equipment plate under the newer service sticker
Maintenance date on the photographed plate

clues.label: Pods take time
clues.text: Fast Plant pods ripen about 20 days after pollination and seeds are ready about 40 days after planting. No action makes them faster.

clues.label: Matching number
clues.text: This equipment number matches the old trial card.

clues.label: Label under a label
clues.text: Photograph it. Do not peel the only original.

clues.label: Old trial-stage chart
clues.text: The 2034 chart records seedlings only. Reproductive stage: not reached.

clues.label: Unsupported owner card
clues.text: A device match is not a person’s name.

clues.label: Seedling, not flower
clues.text: And a seedling record is not a previous flower.

clues.label: One match per field
clues.text: Date, device, channel. Each gets one supported match.

clues.label: Real archive labels
clues.text: Real NASA archives label every record with its date, instrument and channel. The 2034 tokens in this puzzle are fiction.

clues.label: Engineer channel, 2034
clues.text: Biological trial suspended. Crew retreat is mandatory.

clues.label: N.'s memory, 2034
clues.text: My grandmother’s mustard fields turned yellow every winter. I wanted some of that light here.

clues.label: A familiar voice
clues.text: That sounds like Ferreira. Younger, maybe.

clues.label: Receipt is not reply
clues.text: Delivered is not the same as answered.

investigation.text: Put flower, pods, drying and harvest in order.
Compare the recorder's number with the old trial card.
Photograph the plate instead of peeling the sticker.
Read what stage the 2034 trial reached.
Keep the owner card off the board; leave the person slot empty.
Check that the local copy is intact. The original stays untouched.
Play or read the dated engineering channel.
Sort each statement into Observed, Inferred or Unknown.
Pack the evidence for Ferreira without guesses.

steps.label: Classify the voice resemblance as an inference
Send the intact copy to Ferreira

life_cycle.prompt: Which order do Fast Plants follow after pollination?

options.label: Flower, developing pods, mature pods, drying, harvest
options.feedback: Yes. Harvest comes after the pods mature and dry, weeks from now.

options.label: Pollinated today, harvest tomorrow
options.feedback: Pods ripen about 20 days after pollination. A finished task does not make seeds ready.

label_handling.prompt: How do you read the older plate under the newer sticker?

options.label: Photograph it through the lifted corner
options.feedback: The original stays intact and the photo becomes a source card.

label_handling.note: Peeling is never offered as an action (22 §4.3).

trial_stage.prompt: What does the old trial-stage chart support?

options.label: An earlier trial stopped before flowering
options.feedback: The chart and the seedling record support this. Alo's bloom is still a first.

options.label: An earlier flowering garden makes Alo's first bloom false
options.feedback: The chart says the reproductive stage was not reached. Narrow the claim to what it shows.

date.prompt: Which date belongs in File A?

options.feedback: Matches the maintenance date on the plate.
That is today, when the copy was made. The plate's maintenance date disagrees.

options.label: HORT-01
options.feedback: HORT-01 is a device identifier, not a date. Dates, devices and channels are different fields.

device.prompt: Which device belongs in File B?

options.label: ENGINEERING
options.feedback: ENGINEERING is a channel label, not a device. The equipment plate disagrees.

options.label: N.
options.feedback: A device match is not a person's name. The equipment plate names the device.

channel.prompt: Which channel belongs in File C?

options.label: PERSONAL
options.feedback: The personal note is a different channel. File C's channel label says ENGINEERING.
2034-04 is a date, not a channel. Dates, devices and channels are different fields.

checksum_meaning.prompt: What does a matching checksum prove?

options.label: The local copy is internally intact
options.feedback: Yes. It supports reliable playback and nothing more.

options.label: Who is speaking in the recording
options.feedback: A checksum tests the data, not the people. Technical checks and interpretation are separate claims.

classification.prompt: Sort each statement into Observed, Inferred or Unknown.

statements.feedback: The engineering channel recorded it, with a date.
N.'s channel says it in N.'s own recorded words.
Sounding like someone is an inference. Keep it, with its date, and ask.
Nothing on the board names N. The person slot stays empty.

classification.wrong_feedback: Which statements did someone actually record, and which are our guesses?

package.prompt: What goes in the evidence package for Ferreira?

items.label: A line guessing the gardener's name
items.feedback: Leave the name as a question. The package carries evidence, not guesses.

package.receipt_note: A delivery receipt confirms transport. It is not a reply and does not show agreement.

feedback.wrong_token: This token disagrees with its source label. It stays removable; check which source disagrees.
feedback.playback_locked: Playback stays locked until date, device and channel all match.
feedback.checksum_locked: Match date, device and channel before checking the local copy.
feedback.engineer_first: Read the dated engineering fragment before the paired memory note.
feedback.classify_first: Keep voice resemblance as an inference before sending the evidence.
feedback.send_first: Send the intact copy before acknowledging the handover.
feedback.reset_keeps_evidence: Reset returns the tokens. Collected evidence stays on the board.

tokens: Dates, devices and channels are different fields.
life_cycle: Which picture is from our garden, and which only shows what comes later?
Flowers, then pods, then drying, then harvest.
Flower (ours, now) → mature pods (reference only) → harvest (later).
classification: Which statements did someone actually record, and which are our guesses?
A voice that 'sounds like' someone goes under Inferred.
Example: 'Retreat ordered, 2034' → Observed. 'Voice resembles Ferreira' → Inferred. 'Writer's name' → Unknown.

limits: The 2034 recorder, its tokens and both voices are fiction. N. stays anonymous here; the board never names the gardener.

open_reconstructed_transcript.confirm: The transcript opens from the intact local copy. The original recorder stays untouched.

play_engineer_fragment.confirm: Engineer, stored 2034 recording: "Biological trial suspended. Crew retreat is mandatory."

play_n_memory.confirm: N., stored 2034 recording: "My grandmother's mustard fields turned yellow every winter. I wanted some of that light here."

acknowledge_handover.confirm: Delivered is not the same as answered. The evening handover is logged; the reply column stays empty.

flight_rules: MP-04 · Verify a label against an independent source; work on a local copy and leave the original untouched.

risk.title: Original evidence destroyed
risk.level: MODERATE · removed by photographing, not peeling

panel.wrong_idea: An earlier flowering garden makes Alo's first bloom false.

first_time_card.title: Rebuild the recorder copy
first_time_card.purpose: Give each file the one value its own source label supports. Playback stays locked until all three match.
steps: Read the photographed plate, date and channel labels.
Put one token in each file's empty slot.
Check the local copy, then open the transcript.
